recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist 1980s composition featuring a giant human figure leaning over a swimming pool reflecting a golden sunset, juxtaposed with two small figures standing on a geometric concrete platform against a deep blue sky.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme scale contrast between the foreground giant and background miniature figures
Diagonal tension created by the pool edge and concrete patterns
Color temperature clash between cool blue sky and warm golden water reflections
Vertical red sidebar (obi) providing a structural anchor for dense typography
coreInvariants: High-angle perspective looking down at the pool
Geometric white lines on gray concrete
Deep blue sky gradient without clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large-scale human arm and head dominate the left foreground; two small full-body figures stand in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical red band on the left acts as the primary layout anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the pool edge from bottom left to top right, connecting the giant figure to the small figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The vast blue sky in the upper center provides breathing room for the display typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the water and sky contrasted with the neutral grays of the concrete and white of the suits.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Forward slash used as a stylistic separator with extra spacing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide-tracked geometric display face paired with a dense, functional sans-serif for technical information.
graphicDevices: Small illustrative icons/logos in the sidebar

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric 70s/80s aesthetic and uniform stroke weight.
Provides the necessary geometric purity and uppercase elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a giant human figure in the foreground leaning over a swimming pool. The pool water reflects a bright golden sunset. In the background, two small men in 1980s suits stand on a gray concrete platform with white painted geometric lines. The sky is a clear, deep cobalt blue gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical red band on the far left. Place white geometric sans-serif text in the top right corner with wide tracking. Add dense blocks of white technical text and small icons within the red sidebar.

verificationChecks: Is the scale contrast between the foreground and background figures extreme?
Does the water have a distinct golden-orange rippled texture?
Is the display text in a clean, uppercase geometric sans-serif?
Is the red sidebar present on the left edge?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display typography
Angle of the pool edge diagonal
mustRedesign: Specific Japanese characters must be replaced with generic placeholder text
Original artist names must be replaced with generic titles
Logos must be replaced with abstract geometric shapes
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red sidebar does not obscure the main figure's face.
Check that the white text is legible against the blue sky.
Verify the perspective lines of the concrete match the pool edge.
Confirm the scale of the background figures remains 'miniature' relative to the foreground.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Surreal Scale Photography] + [Geometric Sans-Serif Typography] + [Japanese Obi Strip Layout] + [Sunset/Blue Sky Palette].
